dt-example.title: Auto-locale display (Intl)
dt-example.info:
DataTables' [build in `datetime` renderer](https://datatables.net/manual/core/data/renderers#Built-in-helpers) can be used to provide locale specific output rendering for a date / time. This is done using the [`Intl.DateTimeFormat` object that is built into modern browsers](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/DateTimeFormat) so no external dependencies are required.
In this example, the data loaded contains an ISO8601 data point, which we use `DataTable.render.date()` on to provide a locale specific output - i.e. the date shown will be in the format that the end user expects to see, regardless of where they are in the world. No extra configuration or server-side detection is needed by you, it is all done client-side based on the browser's settings.
